title: Mangal Dosha
content: Aapki kundali me Mangal Dosha maujud hai kyunki Mangal saptam bhav me baitha hai. Iska asar aapke vivah aur saath jeevan par pad sakta hai. Jeevansathi ke saath chhoti baat par jhagda ho sakta hai aur gussa zyada aata hai. Thoda dhairya rakhne se yeh dosha apna asar kam kar deta hai.
field3: Mangalvar ko Hanuman Chalisa ka path karein aur lal masoor ka daan karein. Vivah se pehle Kundali milan zaroor karayein.

title: Kaal Sarp Dosha
content: Aapki kundali me Kaal Sarp Dosha nahi hai kyunki sabhi grah Rahu-Ketu ke beech nahi hain. Iska matlab hai ki aapke jeevan me bade sangharsh nahi aayenge. Aapki mehnat ka fal samay par milega aur bhagya saath dega. Sitaron ki kripa aap par bani rahegi.
field3: Shiv ji ki puja Somvar ko karein aur Om Namah Shivaya ka jaap karein. Yeh aapki raksha karega.

title: Pitru Dosha
content: Aapki kundali me halka Pitru Dosha dikh raha hai kyunki Surya aur Chandra par Shani ka prabhav hai. Isse aapke parivar me kuch rukavatein aa sakti hain. Santan aur aarthik mamlon me thodi deri ho sakti hai. Purvajon ka aashirwad lene se yeh dosha shant hota hai.
field3: Amavasya ko pitru tarpan karein aur brahman ko bhojan karayein. Gaya ya Haridwar me shraddh karana bhi faydemand hai.

title: Mangal Dosha
content: Aapki kundali me Mangal Dosha nahi hai kyunki Mangal ki sthiti shubh hai. Aapka vivah sukh se hoga aur jeevansathi ke saath prem bana rahega. Chhoti-moti takraar sabhi rishton me hoti hai, lekin yeh gambhir nahi hai. Aap apne partner ko samman dein to rishta mazboot rahega.
field3: Mangalvar ko Hanuman ji ke darshan karein aur lal phool chadhayein. Yeh aapke vivah me sukh laayega.
